correctness.rationale: In the original and repaired arguments, the semisimple parts commute, products of arrows vanish, and each nonloop arrow coefficient is a linear functional of its own 2t variables, with signed endpoint differences as coefficients. Loops and vertices vanish; when the endpoint labels agree the fiber has q^(2t) lifts for a zero target and none otherwise, and when they disagree each coefficient has q^(2t−1) lifts. The arrow variable blocks are disjoint (also for parallel arrows), including in characteristic two. Summing over all vertex labels gives the repaired formula. Expansion of q to the equal-arrow indicator as 1+(q−1) times the equality indicator, arrow by arrow, gives the contraction formula; a retained collapsed hard edge rules out its coloring. A full-support K5 over F2 needs five colors, so its two-pair count is 2^30 times the falling factorial (16)_5. The original length criterion follows by positivity of the sum, t=0 is the zero target, and the original cumulative formula counts supports with (q−1)^|S| assignments each. The original uploaded checker was inspected, not executed; its actual fiber tests use t=1. The independent exact reproduction used direct pairs and convolution, and the new checker was run for t=2,3 on all nonempty fibers and the total counts.

originality.rationale: For the repaired claim alone, the natural repeated-pair law has a direct mixed Potts evaluation with q^(2t) vertex states and fixed soft edge weight q−1. The closest exact indexed findings have the loopless length theorem and single-pair coloring and contraction formulas; they mechanically cover the original minimum-length and width claims even with loops (which add central arrow directions). The same-day assigned record 3 has the t=1 contraction formula on a narrower quiver class; no same-day priority is claimed. Neither replacing q by q^t nor knowing length gives the repeated-fiber formula. Exact convolution of the old law is acknowledged; what survives is a closed evaluation of that convolution in terms of the single prescribed support, not the mere ability to compute it.

value.rationale: For a prescribed target, minimum length tells whether the fiber exists but not its size. The repaired law counts ordered decompositions of that target at every multiple-pair arity via one graph evaluation rather than iterating all possible intermediate targets; even on threshold-obstructed examples it gives the exact count once multiple commutators are allowed. The hard support and the soft equality weights separate; this is not just counting loops or recomputing a width. No complexity bound is asserted.
